content.title: Duke's Caleb Foster, Patrick Ngongba cleared to play vs St John's in Sweet 16
content.text: BASKETBALLDuke basketball's Caleb Foster, Patrick Ngongba cleared for Sweet 16 game vs St. John's Anna SnyderFayetteville ObserverMarch 27, 2026, 5:34 p.m. ETKeep WatchingWASHINGTON, D.C. — Caleb Foster and Patrick Ngongba II have both been cleared to play for Duke basketball's Sweet 16 meeting against St. John's 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament on Friday, March 27, from Capital One Arena.Both were listed as questionable in Thursday night's initial injury report, but were removed entirely on the gameday report that was released around 5:15 p.m. ET on Friday.Foster has not played since March 7 against UNC, fracturing a bone in his right foot in the first half. He had surgery immediately following on March 8. Prior to injury, Foster was averaging 8.5 points, 3.6 rebounds and 2.8 assists per game.Ngongba missed five games from March 2-March 21 but saw 13 minutes of action in Duke's second round NCAA Tournament win over TCU. The sophomore center is Duke's third-leading scorer with 10.5 points, 6.0 rebounds and 2.0 assists.Tipoff between No. 1 seeded Duke (34-2) and No. 5 seeded St. John's (30-6) is set for 7:10 p.m. from Capital One Arena.Need a news break?
